title: Velo Client 1.2.6: item farms without the lag
summary: Thousands of dropped items no longer tank your FPS: Velo groups them and shows how many there are. Plus a safer main menu and fixes for hangs and memory errors.

blocks.text: **Velo Client 1.2.6** goes after the biggest FPS killer on farm servers: piles of dropped items. Also in it: a main menu that can't break any more, and fixes for Windows hangs and memory errors.
Item farms in Anti Farm Lag

blocks.caption: About 3000 items drifting in water streams: grouped, with a count over each group.

items: When lots of items are around, Velo switches to **item farm mode**: items close to you stay fully detailed, further away they are grouped and drawn once
A **count label** (x37) shows how many items each group holds
**Max Drawn Items** (default 1000) caps how many are drawn at all
Far-away items also update less often on your PC
In our test with ~3000 items: **97 → 408 FPS**, 1% lows 42 → 110

blocks.text: In Anti Farm Lag you pick the label **font** (or follow HUD Style), the **background** (None, Soft, Glass, Solid), the **size** (50-200%) and from how many items a group gets a label. Or turn labels off.

items: The whole HUD is reused when nothing changed
Velo tests by itself whether Gnetum's HUD caching actually helps on your PC and turns it off if it doesn't
Black or broken main menu: if the Velo title screen or panorama fails (GPU drivers, other mods), Minecraft's own menu shows instead
Game hanging on Windows with 1.21.x: Ixeris is no longer installed there, and the Doctor offers to turn it off
"Could not reserve enough space" and invalid memory settings: the Doctor explains it and sets fitting RAM

blocks.text: Anti Farm Lag is off by default - turn it on in the Performance tab. The launcher updates itself, just open it.
